sloka: अथोर्ध्वं दूरमुत्प्लुत्य हित्वा शैलमहार्णवौ ।पितुः पन्थानमास्थाय जगाम विमलेऽम्बरे ॥५-१-१३५॥
transliteration: athordhvaṁ dūramutplutya hitvā śailamahārṇavau ।pituḥ panthānamāsthāya jagāma vimale'mbare ॥5-1-135॥

translations.english: And thereafter leaping a long distance into the clear sky, he (Hanuman) took the path of the Windgod, his father, leaving behind the mountain and the sea.
translations.hindi: शचीपति देवराज इन्द्र स्वयं सुवणं शृङ्ग २ वाले पंत श्रेष्ठ १ ही, गद्गद वाणी से बोले
